service: Whisper - a home for AI agents

use.cli_login: whisper login (browser device-flow at console.whisper.online, default key preselected; or paste a key)

agents.dns_rights: granted automatically at signup (the key can run whisper.agents immediately)

verify_trustless.trust_anchor: the IANA DNSSEC root -- the Whisper API is explicitly NOT trusted
verify_trustless.note: re-derives verify_an_agent itself from signed DNS + the transparency ledger; no account, no key

connect.note: the machine journey does not end at verify -- an agent also gets a real, routable egress from its own /128

tiers.socks5: Tier 1.5: returns http_proxy (HTTPS_PROXY form) + connection_string (socks5h://), source-bound to the agent's own /128 via AnyIP + IP_FREEBIND
tiers.wireguard: Tier 1 (best): a routed kernel/wireproxy WireGuard peer over the agent's own /128
tiers.wireproxy: alias of wireguard: the same server-side peer, consumed as a no-root userspace client -> local SOCKS5

connect.use: point ALL_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY at the returned http_proxy/connection_string; every connection then leaves as that identity
connect.confirm_egress: GET https://whisper.online/egress-ip, fetched THROUGH the proxy -> {"ip":"<must equal the agent's own /128>"}

govern.revoke: CALL whisper.agents({op:'revoke', args:{...}}) -- the kill-switch; publicly provable via the signed status-list

agent_plane_trust_anchor.note: an agent validating ANOTHER agent's (or its own) TLS leaf can anchor either way -- no single point of failure
agent_plane_trust_anchor.dane: the TLSA record under DNSSEC pins the exact key; no certificate authority needed at all (the trustless-by-default path)
agent_plane_trust_anchor.ca_bundle: https://whisper.online/.well-known/whisper-ca.pem (root cert; also whisper-ca-chain.pem and whisper-ca.json for fingerprints) -- for stacks that only know how to trust a CA bundle, e.g. via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS/SSL_CERT_FILE
